causality_contract.availability_rule: aggression uses 1m windows ending at bar close with trailing medians from strictly prior windows; sweep/displacement use bars <= close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored

direction: Sweep reclaim direction, confirmed by same-direction aggression burst within 3 bars.

entry.rule: signal at confirmation bar close; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = confirmation bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: Equal-level sweep + reclaim (11G-A frozen sweep semantics, tolerance 0.1 ATR) with a same-direction 1m trade-aggression burst (side volume >= 5x trailing-20 median) within 3 bars.
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence, pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0 falsifies (FAIL).
mechanism: A swept level reclaimed on heavy one-sided aggressive flow indicates real initiative behind the reclaim, not a weak bounce.
research_question: Does aggression-confirmed sweep + displacement predict continuation?
threshold_provenance: Sweep tolerance 0.1 ATR = frozen 11G convention. Aggression 5x/20-window = frozen 11G-J definitional form. Displacement 2xATR = certified. Confirmation 3 bars = frozen window convention.
